summary: Preserve durable private snapshot history, evidence-graded audience growth, honest engagement cohorts and recipient-weighted campaign benchmarks across reprints.
reason: SendFox does not expose Kit-style growth aggregates, so the CLI must derive reproducible metrics from supplied snapshots without turning missing events, timestamps or scopes into zeros.
validated_outcome: Synthetic tests cover the read-only export/local-write snapshot split, private atomic artifacts, one- and two-snapshot growth, unknown-not-zero handling, engagement cohort completeness, weighted campaign math and MCP discovery; go test ./..., go vet ./... and go build ./... pass on Studio after the split.
